help.title: Need Help Using Our App?
help.subtitle: We're here to support you — quickly and easily.
help.intro: Get step-by-step guidance on using the app's features like invoice generation, templates, and subscription management. Whether you're stuck or just need tips, we're always available to assist.
help.option_video: Watch our quick start video for an overview
help.option_contact: Contact our support team anytime for personalized help
help.commitment: We're committed to making your experience smooth and productive.
help.video_title: Watch our quick start video for an overview
help.free_1: View your order list directly on the dashboard or through the Shopify Orders page.
help.free_2: Manually generate invoices and email them to your customers.
help.free_3: Customize your invoice design from the Settings > Invoice tab by selecting your preferred template.
help.free_4: Easily generate, print, download PDF invoices, or resend them to customers as needed.
help.premium_intro: Upgrade to unlock automation and advanced customization:
help.auto_1: Go to Settings > General to enable automatic invoice generation.
help.auto_2: Choose to send invoices to customers, store owners, or a custom email address.
help.auto_3: Once enabled, the system will automatically create and email PDF invoices immediately after an order is placed.
help.email_1: Navigate to Settings > Email to configure your own SMTP settings.
help.email_2: Customize the email template layout and content to match your brand.
help.email_3: Ensure customers receive professional, personalized invoice emails with every order.
